logLevel._comment_AzureCore: The queue trigger polls storage every maxPollingInterval whether or not a push is due, and the Azure SDK logs each poll's request and response at Information. Measured in production: 2340 Azure.Core records an hour, flat, against 4 actual pushes an hour - 95% of the workspace's whole ingestion, and constant regardless of how many devices are registered. That is 3.3 GB a month of the 5 GB free grant spent on watching an idle queue.

samplingSettings._comment: Exceptions are never sampled: the poison-queue LogError is the single most important signal in the push pipeline, and it fires rarely enough that sampling would be free to drop it entirely.
